pool.text: Guru Ram Das founded the holy town of Amritsar
Guru Ram Das's son installed the scripture inside the new temple
Mahima Prakash Vartak was likely composed describing construction achievements
Ahmad Shah of the Durrani Empire invaded the Sikh Confederacy
Maharaja Ranjit Singh fortified the city starting from a wall
The British annexed Punjab when Amritsar was a walled city
The city's first local administrative body was established as a Town Committee
Amritsar was notified as a city under the Punjab Municipal Corporation Act
Indira Gandhi ordered Operation Blue Star to remove militants from the temple
The first election to the Municipal Corporation was conducted in fifty wards
Elections were held after the number of wards was increased
Brij Mohan Kapur was elected Mayor of the municipal body
The third municipal election took place with the mayoral election
Elections and the mayoral election for Amritsar took place
An elevated road with four lanes connected to the highway started
The present Municipal House was constituted in the city
The craft of the Thatheras of Jandiala Guru got enlisted
Amritsar became the second-most populous city in Punjab according to the United Nations
The Amritsar Metrobus bus rapid transit service was launched
The most recent municipal elections were conducted in Amritsar
